echoes.name: Troll's Echo
echoes.desc: The troll's stubborn will to knit itself back together lingers in you.

active.name: Troll's Mend
active.desc: Flesh knits closed at speed, once in a while.

echoes.name: Bear's Echo
echoes.desc: A patient, crushing strength settles into your shoulders.

active.name: Bear's Roar
active.desc: A roar that shakes nearby beasts' nerve.

echoes.name: Wyvern's Echo
echoes.desc: You land softer than you should, as if wings remember for you.

active.name: Wyvern's Dive
active.desc: A short, weightless glide toward danger.

echoes.name: Corrupted Wolf's Echo
echoes.desc: Your eyes catch what little light there is; beasts sense the wrongness in you and hesitate.

active.name: Howl of the Pack
active.desc: A corrupted howl that scatters lesser beasts.

echoes.name: Spider Queen's Echo
echoes.desc: You notice the thread before it moves.

active.name: Silkbind
active.desc: Threads of old silk snare a foe's feet.

echoes.name: Ogre Warlord's Echo
echoes.desc: A slow, ember-hot temper you can call on, and put away again.

active.name: Ashborn Fury
active.desc: A brief surge of an ogre's raw strength.

echoes.name: Companion's Echo
echoes.source_hint: a Soul-Named companion who has died
echoes.desc: The bond doesn't break; it just stops needing them beside you.

active.name: Call the Bond
active.desc: For a moment, you fight as they once did at your side.

echoes.name: Guardian's Echo
echoes.source_hint: a Soul-Named guardian who has died protecting you
echoes.desc: A steadiness that was theirs, now yours to lean on.

echoes.name: Mentor's Echo
echoes.desc: Their lessons keep teaching, long after the lesson is over.

active.name: Mentor's Guidance
active.desc: For a while, every strike lands the way they showed you.

echoes.name: Family Echo
echoes.desc: Home is quieter now, but it still holds you up.

active.name: Ancestor's Blessing
active.desc: A moment of calm that steadies hands and nerve.

echoes.name: Rift Whisper
echoes.source_hint: standing too near an opening Rift
echoes.desc: Something on the other side noticed you, and left a mark.

active.name: Rift Step
active.desc: A short, sickening lurch sideways through the world.

echoes.name: Rift Scar
echoes.source_hint: surviving a Rift phenomenon at close range
echoes.desc: A cold that never quite leaves, and never quite hurts either.

active.name: Scarred Calm
active.desc: Fear slides off you, briefly, entirely.
